description: Synthetic caller speech from Rime (voices carol on Mist v2 and albion on Coda, both listed by Rime as British), requested as 16 kHz PCM from Rime's HTTP API by case-build/render_caller_audio.py. The voices are AI-generated, not recordings of a person. Rime is the agent's text-to-speech vendor (as vashti on Coda) but not its speech-to-text vendor, so Deepgram never transcribes its own voice. OpenAI was not used, and Gemini TTS was out of daily quota. The accent is Rime's catalogue label; nobody on the build team has listened to confirm it.

accent.requested: British English (en-GB): two voices Rime's public catalogue lists as British (carol: country UK, dialect British; albion: country GB, dialect English)
accent.status: listed by the vendor as British, not verified by a listener
accent.gemini_attempt: Gemini gemini-3.8-flash-tts with director's notes asking for a southern English accent and languageCode en-GB rendered 21 of 47 lines, then returned HTTP 429 at its 100-requests-per-model daily cap (2026-09-30). Those files were not used; their cost is in the ledger. Gemini also accepted a made-up languageCode (xx-QQ) without error, so its language code is no evidence of accent.
